NATIONAL TRANSPORTATION SAFETY BOARD

[Docket No.: NTSB-2026-0034]


Office of the Managing Director: Chief Data Officer; Fiscal Year 
(FY) 2026-2030 Strategic Plan

AGENCY: National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB).

ACTION: Notice of final publication.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The NTSB announces the availability of the following 
publication: ``NTSB FY 2026-2030 Strategic Plan''.

DATES: The plan was published on September 8, 2026.

ADDRESSES: This document may be obtained at the following link: <a href="https://www.ntsb.gov/about/reports/Documents/FY26-30%20Strategic%20Plan.pdf">https://www.ntsb.gov/about/reports/Documents/FY26-30%20Strategic%20Plan.pdf</a>.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: Warren Randolph, Chief Data Officer, 
<a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#e4979096859081838d879488858aa48a909786ca838b92"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="25565157445140424c465549444b654b5156470b424a53">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: On June 10, 2026, the NTSB published a 
Federal Register notice [91 FR 35275] inviting public comments on the 
development of the NTSB's Strategic Plan for fiscal years 2026-2030. 
All comments received were reviewed and considered in finalizing the 
current document.

William T. McMurry, Jr.,
General Counsel.
